prompt:
Very simple flat 2D maritime survival cartoon. Crisp black outlines, matte solid colours, sparse shallow backgrounds and few large readable props. No photorealism, deep perspective, cinematic realism, elaborate textures or gradients on faces. Human has a perfectly round oversized PURE WHITE head, tiny black oval eyes and small line mouth, no hair, ears, nose, eyebrows or face shading. Thin BLACK stick torso and limbs, WHITE mitten hands and WHITE oval feet. One navy-blue short-brim fisherman cap and a small flat yellow life jacket with two padded flaps and one simple buckle over the thin stick torso. No scarf, bandage or backpack. Compact stick figure matching the approved line-body reference proportions. Adults, not babies. One named individual appears once. Sea creatures have bold simple silhouettes and their own dark teal or desaturated purple colours, huge compared with the small boat, scary through scale and partial visibility rather than gore. Palette: pale dusty blue/cream by day, desaturated navy/teal at night, yellow hero accent. One continuous landscape 16:9 film frame, no words, borders or panels.
DRAWING CONSISTENCY LOCK: The approved DAYLIGHT ROPE scene is the single canonical drawing-language guide. Match its clean outlined 2D shapes, simple face, navy cap shape, yellow vest panels/buckle, pure white face/hands/feet, black stick anatomy and head-to-body proportions in every shot. Changes of action, camera or environment never authorize changing the character design or illustration technique. Night and underwater descriptions change the environment palette only; the character stays flat pure white with the same navy/yellow clothes. No oval/profile/beaked face, extra anatomy, thicker limbs, glossy shading, bloom, rim light, painterly texture, 3D lighting, chibi redesign or realistic rendering. Use two tiny black eyes and a short simple mouth, no drawn human features. Keep a readable front or three-quarter round head when the face is visible. Sea creatures use the same outlined flat illustration language, simple threatening shapes, not goofy smiling faces. Background coherence and drawing consistency are independent; free backgrounds still keep this same drawing language.

ONE Marin is clearly readable in the foreground, round white head with two tiny black eyes and a short worried mouth, navy cap and yellow two-panel life vest exactly matching the identity/drawing guides. Both white mitten hands grip the low starboard rail. ONE enormous desaturated purple tentacle with a few large simple suction cups rises from the water beyond the rail, towering over him. Preserve the master cabin, teal door/windows, lifebuoy, rusty red hull, foredeck hatch and low rail geometry. A simple dark navy sky and sparse teal water, one pale moon. Match the canonical daytime illustration technique even though the environment is dark. No detailed moody lighting on character or boat, no smoothed oval face, no tiny chibi redesign, no glow, no gradients across white skin. One continuous full-frame 16:9 view, no words.
